items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: his daddy was Grand Prince who wrote a lot of stocks back in the old days. He was a trumpet player with Ben Burnie

ctx.x: He's something else. He's like I said the most unbelievable multi-instrumentalist. You're telling me about him. He was a, his daddy was Grand Prince who wrote a lot of stocks back in the old days. He was a trumpet player with Ben Burnie and all those old-time bands. Yeah there's an awful lot of good players out there. They all have a good symphony orchestra. Yeah.

Well and they have, they had a good reason at one time. I think they've been tearing the Greystone Ballroom down if it's not going I think recently. I don't know. And that was a place that I used to hear people talk about a lot and still do. And of course I never remember there being a big ballroom here in this city like that.
